description: Optional repository attractor construction and maintenance
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- The bundled `attractor` skill defines enduring design qualities and tradeoffs, distinguishes implementation progress, divergence, changed intent, and local exceptions, and routes construction through the project's selected method.
- The default Spec guidance adopts `.memerig/attractor-guide.md`; adopted projects can record confirmed direction and open proposals in `.memerig/spec/attractor.md`. Silent or non-adopting templates receive no attractor-specific questions, tasks, or completion gates.
- Initialization, onboarding, and shared workflow guidance respect template adoption and custom methods. Normal init/update preservation keeps user-authored direction.
**Bug Fixes:**
- The synchronized package-version bump script now executes correctly when invoked directly on Windows.
notes: Run `memerig update` to receive the bundled skill and guide. Installed resources or an existing attractor file do not opt a project in; follow the selected template's explicit adoption and method. No migration is required.
